title: Static Res takes a stand with an unapologetic track of self worth “Nice Guy”
htmlContent:
Static Res makes a powerful statement with their song "Nice Guy," which is about staying true to who you are, no matter what. "Nice Guy" is a genuine look at how we navigate friendships and relationships while trying to maintain our sense of self.

The sound is clear and natural, allowing every word to hit home. You can feel the artist's vulnerability, almost like you're having a heartfelt conversation with them. "Nice Guy" is about realizing your worth and refusing to change to meet other's expectations. Static Res shares the bittersweet truth that being "too nice" can sometimes be misunderstood as a weakness.

https://open.spotify.com/album/4wCQ3zJEmLcMyzUVLFSttB?si=3rMKdk_QR42sosCr0VMeeA

However, the song unfolds with a strong message. It reassures us that staying true to ourselves is the real victory, even if it means losing some people. With this song, Static Res pushes beyond their comfort zone and creates a track that resonates with anyone who has ever doubted their place in the world, only to find that they never needed to change in the first place.
